title: Repair invalid implicit-mesh topology after determinism isolation
description: Current Unity logs report generated implicit meshes with non-zero boundary and non-manifold edges, accompanied by detached polygon islands in the viewport. Do not patch CubeContourResolver or MarchingCubesExtractor heuristically until TSK-0204 identifies whether the scalar field itself is drifting. Once the input field is proven stable, use boundary/non-manifold/winding edge examples plus a minimal reproducer to identify the extraction defect. Acceptance: repeated identical input produces a closed, consistently wound implicit surface with zero boundary edges, zero non-manifold edges, and zero inconsistent-winding edges, with regression coverage for the failing contour configuration.

comments.author: ChatGPT
comments.body: 2026-09-11 evidence: Unity reported 3 boundary/0 non-manifold edges on one run and 4 boundary/7 non-manifold edges on another; the screenshots show detached polygon islands. The topology validator now also reports inconsistent winding examples. First establish field/extraction determinism under TSK-0204 before changing contour logic.
